why: Issue #921. 1px is outside the 2-3px range the UI/UX direction fixes for the focus ring, and every existing focus assertion in this file looks for `outline:` inside a block -- which a 1px ring still satisfies, since all three rules draw from this one token. The ring narrows on every focusable control at once and no gate notices.
